title: When the Thorn Falls
author: Theo Quintana
blurb: Quentin Ashgrove, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
